_role: A: driver cancelled as no-show after threshold; rider-filed, stresses driver cancelled

dispute_ticket.description: I was charged S$6.00 as a no-show but I did not cancel this trip, the driver cancelled, not me. I came down to the lobby of my block and the car was already gone. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: Good morning, I'm at the drop-off point outside Blk 233 lobby, white Prius.
Still waiting at the lobby. Please let me know where you are.
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 25s, no response).
I have waited 9 minutes and cannot reach you. I will have to cancel as no-show.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $6.00 applied.
I'm at the lobby now, where are you? You cancelled on me!

app_events.details: Rider R-5120 booked trip RYDE-CS-001 from Blk 233 Compassvale Lane (lobby drop-off) to Changi Airport Terminal 3. Pickup 07:30.
Driver D-3318 (Lim Teck Hock, Toyota Prius (SMB 2204 K)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 3 min free wait period ends at 07:31.
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 25s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-3318. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$6.00 charged to rider payment method (e-wallet).
Driver D-3318 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 07:28:00 (driver_arrived event, GPS at the pickup point 07:28 to 07:37). Cancellation was pressed by the driver at 07:37:00, a wait of 9 minutes, which is past this trip's 6-minute no-show threshold (and past the 3-minute free wait). The driver messaged twice and called; the rider only replied at 07:41, after the cancel. The policy covers the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold, so the S$6.00 fee is due. That the driver (not the rider) pressed cancel does not remove the fee.
